verdict.rationale: Polar is an API-first billing platform that can be driven programmatically without its dashboard: official typed SDKs, a dedicated API, a `polar listen` CLI for webhook forwarding, and an isolated sandbox for integration testing. Nothing documents CI pipelines specifically, and the MCP path relies on interactive browser OAuth, so headless CI automation is only implied. Missing for 10: documented CI/headless usage guidance, non-interactive auth (API tokens) for automation, a full CLI beyond webhook listening, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Call the Polar API with full type safety using one of our official SDKs.
The official Python SDK provides fully typed synchronous and asynchronous clients for the Polar API.
To test Polar or work on your integration without worrying about actual money processing or breaking your live organization, you can use our sandbox environment.
If you want to integrate more deeply the checkout process with your website or application, you can use our dedicated API.
